newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Cholera kills six in Venezuela.
newsitem.headline: Cholera kills six in Venezuela.

text.p: Cholera has killed six people among 162 cases reported in Venezuela in the past 10 days, mainly in an area bordering Colombia, a Health Ministry official said on Wednesday.
All the deaths and 155 of the confirmed cases were in western Zulia state bordering Colombia, Oswaldo Godoy, director of the ministry's Epidemic Watch unit, told Reuters.
Godoy said four suspected new cases had been detected in the capital Caracas.
Cholera, primarily spread by poor hygiene or drinking water contaminated by sewage, causes severe diarrhoea, vomiting and dehydration.
